So, we don't see this because of the CI-skipped issue :clown_face: 
I attempted to fix the skip in #121734.

The original duplication _might_ cause a compile error, but different C/C++ compiler versions may be lenient to identical typedefs. To be on the safe side (also in presence of toolchain changes) I also opened #121733.
